statement.p: Compute the length of the curve {\bf r\it(t)} = 9 t {\bf \, i} + 6 t {\bf \, j} +(t^2 - 3){\bf \, k} over the interval 0 \le t \le 8.
HINT: use the formula \int \sqrt{ t^2 + a^2} \, dt = \frac{1}{2} t \sqrt{t^2+a^2} + \frac{1}{2} a^2 \ln \left( t + \sqrt{t^2+a^2} \right) + C

static.solution:
\bf r\it(t) is \bf r\it'(t)=9 {\bf \, i}+6{\bf \, j}+2t{\bf \, k}.Using the Arc Length Formula we get: L = \int_0^{8} \left||\bf r\it'(t)\right||\,dt =\int_0^{8} \sqrt{{9}^2+{6}^2+(2t)^2}\,dt =\int_0^{8}\sqrt{4t^2+117}\,dt We substitute u=2t, \,du=2\,dt and use the given integration formula. This gives: L=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{16}\sqrt{u^2+117}\,du= \left.\frac{1}{4}u\sqrt{u^2+117}+\frac{1}{4}\cdot 117\ln\left(u+\sqrt{u^2+117}\right)\right|_0^{16}=
\frac{1}{4}16\sqrt{{16}^2+117}+\frac{117}{4}\ln\left(16+\sqrt{{16}^2+117}\right) - \frac{117}{4}\ln\sqrt{117}
=\frac{8}{2}\sqrt{373}+\frac{117}{4}\ln\left(16+\sqrt{373}\right) - \frac{117}{4}\ln\sqrt{117}=
\frac{8}{2}\sqrt{373}+\frac{117}{4}\ln\frac{16+\sqrt{373}}{\sqrt{117}} \approx 111.86
